import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data.split()[0])
    MOD = 1000000007

    previous = [0] * (n + 1)
    sum_val = 0

    for row in range(n + 1):
        previous[row] = 1
        if (row & 1) == 1:
            sum_val = (sum_val + 1) % MOD

    for col in range(1, n + 1):
        current = [0] * (n + 1)
        for row in range(col, n + 1):
            above = 0 if row == col else current[row - 1]
            current[row] = (previous[row] + above) % MOD
            if ((row + col) & 1) == 1:
                sum_val = (sum_val + current[row]) % MOD
        previous = current

    print(sum_val)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
